parameters.positive_prompt: A full-length photograph of a Chinese woman in her early thirties, framed from head to feet with a little space above her hair and below her shoes, standing on a smooth mid-grey seamless studio floor against the same grey backdrop. She is one metre seventy-three tall, seven and a half head-heights from crown to sole, fine-boned and full-figured: narrow waist, rounded hips, long legs, elegant shoulders. Her face is an elegant oval with high cheekbones, a soft defined jawline and a small rounded chin; dark almond-shaped eyes with heavy lids and calm dark-brown irises; softly tapered black brows; a straight slender nose with a fine tip; a full mouth with a defined cupid's bow and rose-pink lips. Long glossy jet-black hair, parted slightly off centre, hangs straight and falls past her waist. Her skin is one even ivory tone from hairline to hands, unmade-up, matte and alive with fine texture and visible pores. She stands with her weight evenly on both feet, shoulders square and relaxed, arms hanging loosely a little away from her body, palms facing in, fingers straight; chin level, eyes level and quietly meeting the lens, lips together in a calm, self-possessed expression. She wears a fitted ivory silk blouse with the top button open, tucked into high-waisted charcoal wool trousers with a thin black leather belt, and black pointed-toe leather pumps with a low heel. Soft directional daytime light comes from a large window at the upper left, gentle shadow falloff down her right side. Palette of sixty percent warm grey studio, thirty percent charcoal, ten percent ivory and skin. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, natural skin texture, gentle film grain, restrained naturalistic colour.
